race.title: BAR 1 Betting Bet Builder Boost Handicap (0-60)
race.verdict: HOOVES YOUR DADDY ran up to her best when staying on for fourth here last time and looks worth a try at this longer trip. She could be ready to get off the mark, though Wegotogether arrives in good heart and isn't taken lightly back in headgear. Una Matata and Jazzy Dancer complete the shortlist. HOOVES YOUR DADDY (IRE) WEGOTOGETHER (IRE) UNA MATATA (IRE)
